readerCopy.body: An old hurt can look different once the desire, anger, or boundary that was shamed out of the story is allowed back in. When Chiron conjoins Lilith, sensitivity and refusal intensify together, bringing an old rejection or criticism into contact with the part that became harder to admit afterward. There may be less willingness to keep treating a desire or refusal as embarrassing simply because it once drew criticism. The pressure is not only around what hurt; it is around what had to stay hidden afterward. The meaning of the old injury can change once the missing want is allowed to count as part of the story.
